statements.markdown:
This is orthogonality of characters applied to the count; nothing is estimated. Its meaning is that ASK, a count of prime powers p i ≤ a/w whose Frobenius avoids Φ, weighted so that each contributes about 2 log p · a/p i , has an explicit main term, and that its deviation from the main term is a combination of the sums G ψ at the points a/w(ρ). An upper bound for ASK is therefore a one-sided statement about those sums.
